notes.title: Checkpoint Update
notes.notes: Since a few of you requested it, I have now added checkpoints where you can save the game.

notes.title: Small Hotfix
notes.notes: Since many had issues understanding certain game mechanics, I added some tips and explanations at the beginning. Furthermore, as many requested, I've now incorporated controller support, at least in-game. The menu navigation doesn't yet work with a controller, but I'm working on it.
